issue.title: sase.service housekeeping reaps ~/.sase/tmp instead of $SASE_TMPDIR; agent cargo-targets grew to 67 GiB unreaped
issue.description:
The managed-tmp reaper and disk-pressure monitor run inside the systemd user unit `sase.service` and never see `SASE_TMPDIR`. That variable is exported only in `~/.profile` (`export SASE_TMPDIR=$HOME/.cache/sase/tmp`), and `~/.sase/service/env` captures only `PATH`. As a result `managed_tmpdir_root()` in the housekeeping routine falls back to `~/.sase/tmp`, while launched agents write TMPDIR/CARGO_TARGET_DIR into `~/.cache/sase/tmp`. The real managed root is never reaped.

Observed on apollo, 2026-09-21:
- `/` is at 98% (5.7 GiB free of 193 GiB). `~/.cache/sase/tmp/cargo-targets` holds 224 per-agent target dirs totaling 67 GiB, including 82 dirs (8.4 GiB) older than the 3-day build_scratch horizon and 60 GiB older than 12h.
- The latest `managed_tmp_reap` result (`~/.sase/axe/lumberjacks/housekeeping/chops/managed_tmp_reap/runs/20260921T153918_*.result.json`) reports `scanned=1 subdirs=0 reason=nothing_stale`, with `pressure_trigger=free_space` active.
- Disk-pressure notifications list only `rust_prebuild_cache 2.9 GiB` as a top owner. They never attribute the 67 GiB cargo-targets bucket.
- `/proc/<pid>/environ` for the `sase axe routine run housekeeping` process has no `SASE_TMPDIR`, but agent processes do.

Likely fix directions: have the service env capture `SASE_TMPDIR` (and other SASE_* path overrides) alongside PATH, and/or have the reaper and disk-footprint scan also cover the root that launched agents actually received. It would also help to warn when the configured root differs from the one agents use.

task_type_fields.impact: Disk fills to 98% on apollo; pressure reaping and disk-pressure attribution are silently ineffective for every agent build tree.
task_type_fields.repro: Compare tr '\0' '\n' </proc/<housekeeping-pid>/environ | grep SASE_TMPDIR (absent) with an agent env (SASE_TMPDIR=~/.cache/sase/tmp); read latest managed_tmp_reap result.json: scanned=1 subdirs=0 nothing_stale while ~/.cache/sase/tmp/cargo-targets is 67 GiB.

payload.description: Also a sase.service/host process-environment defect on a host; fix may touch service env capture

payload.entry: Fixed in code by sase-165.6 (529d7d325): capture_service_environment now keeps SASE_TMPDIR and SASE_HOME; service readiness warns when the shell's managed tmp root differs from the captured one; managed_tmp_reap always logs its scanned root and warns when the default root still holds entries outside it; disk-footprint tests cover cargo-targets under the effective root. Remaining host action (user, interactive shell with SASE_TMPDIR exported): 'sase service init --yes' on each host, then a service restart so housekeeping inherits it; athena's ~/.sase/service/env still lacks SASE_TMPDIR as of 2026-09-22 (sase service init --diff shows +SASE_TMPDIR, +SASE_FEATURE_FLAGS). Not run from an agent shell because it would capture the agent's PATH/flags.
